title: Guerrilla Public Service 2011
summary: Richard Ankrom's account of his 2001 guerrilla project, in which he painted and installed a missing freeway exit sign on a Pasadena freeway. The sign matched official standards and stayed up for years before being discovered.
why: HN cites it as the best-known example of a citizen quietly fixing public infrastructure, often in threads on unsanctioned civic repairs.

quote.text: If you've not heard of Richard Ankrom who fixed an exit sign on the 110 freeway, check it out.
